cohort: 37 pregnant women who delivered vaginally and 29 who underwent elective cesarean section.
finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with higher oxidative stress markers in both umbilical arterial and venous blood compared to elective cesarean section, suggesting that labor stress contributes to oxidative stress in newborns.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with higher oxidative stress markers in newborns, while elective cesarean section was not.
